imperative.ax: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, or debugging code that uses @ax-llm/ax, such as signatures, structured generation, agents, model providers, MCP, flows, optimization, or refinement.
imperative.clarity: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with writing or rewriting prose for people or agents, such as docs, READMEs, announcements, PR descriptions, commit messages, product copy, skills, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md, or with explaining how or why code works. Do not apply it to code-only changes.
imperative.clerk: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with adding, changing, or debugging Clerk authentication, such as sign-in, protected routes, sessions, organizations, billing, webhooks, the Clerk CLI or Backend API, or auth tests.
imperative.cloudflare: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, debugging, or deploying code for Cloudflare, such as Workers, Pages, D1, KV, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, the Agents SDK, Wrangler configuration, or Cloudflare security and networking.
imperative.convex: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, reviewing, or debugging a Convex backend, such as schemas, queries, mutations, actions, indexes, crons, auth, components, migrations, or deployments.
imperative.design-engineering: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, or reviewing UI components in a web or React Native app, such as forms and accessibility, toasts and notifications, animation and motion, typography, color, layout, or product copy.
imperative.expo: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, debugging, or upgrading an Expo app, such as routes and navigation, data fetching, native UI, native modules, SDK upgrades, EAS builds, hosting, or OTA updates.
imperative.react-native: Always apply this skill when you are tasked with building, changing, debugging, or profiling a React Native app, such as crashes, slow screens and long lists, animations and gestures, native modules, navigation, or upgrades.
